responsibility: Implements a simple temporary-variable SSA detector over gm2 scopes and quad read/write metadata. It recursively walks modules and procedures, visits each scope once, checks whether temporary symbols have exactly one write and no earlier read using `GetWriteQuads` and `GetReadQuads`, and records the result with `PutVariableSSA`, providing lightweight single-assignment discovery rather than a full SSA transformation framework.
same_name_distinction: This `.mod` file contains the implementation of SSA discovery, recursively visiting scopes and marking temporaries single-assignment from quad read/write information; the same-name `.def` file just publishes the feature flag and entry routine.
